review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen bundle. The complete implementation and declaration evidence supports index.js and index.d.ts as maintained owners; the exact writable scope also includes both required regression files without requiring unnecessary edits. package.json establishes separate runtime and tsd validation through xo && ava && tsd. The test excerpts are explicitly truncated, but the supplied evidence is sufficient to establish the planning scope and validation entry points; it does not establish test execution or existing complete coverage. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree across the specification and Gold. The implementation/independent-verification split and dependency are consistent. The supplied project-scoped active trusted claims support the allowed implementer and verifier, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async, integration.consumer, and verifier-only testing.verification; pending security.authorization claims are not needed by this feature. An independent active non-executing reviewer is supplied as required by the stated risk-review policy. No material unresolved DEC-001 is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints match; the different manifest/evaluation source digests and original/saved PRD digests are explained by their documented domains and trim-only persistence normalization. Repository, team, decision-input, prompt, model, sampling, policy, and budget fingerprints are frozen consistently. The supplied isolation facts place this Gold before every candidate on this bundle and distinguish retained old-version operations from fresh evaluation. I relied on the Service-supplied mechanical digest bindings and provenance, did not independently recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation, and did not use candidate outputs.
